x: In his current form and with 30,000 screaming Frenchmen rooting for him, Michel Jazy just couldn't fail.Gamoudi of Tunisia was actually hissed by the crowd for not hanging on.
John plumped for the 3,000, where our boys clashed with the redoubtable Michel Jazy. Geoff led the field for 2½ laps and then John took over, dropping all except Jazy.

It could have been the 100 yards - Radford's 9.5 secs. is still unbeaten - or even the mile where the exiled Hungarian, Lazlo Tabori, beat Wiggs and Michel Jazy and all eight runners bettered the Championship best performance.
Shortly afterwards he finished second to the great Michel Jazy over 3,000 metres at La Baule. Our subject had not been idle during the intervening winters.
